decomposition_falsification.result: The 84 stock 64-column CTAs can emit aligned BF16-post-rounding FP32 sum-of-squares partials, and the CPU oracle proves the 64-leaf fragments compose bitwise to the registered 8192-leaf tree. This path still stores and rereads down BF16, adds 672 global bytes per row plus producer square/reduction work, and needs the same finalizer. The selected no-partial finalizer therefore saves 672 more bytes per row and leaves the tuned producer untouched.

A portable eight-CTA SM90a cluster covers 512 of 5,376 columns, requiring 11 clusters. DSM and cluster barriers do not cross clusters, so exact two-stage row normalization still needs a global phase/materialization. Serializing one cluster requires 11 producer tile slots per CTA instead of the stock 84-CTA 0.636-wave grid. The legal materializing repair is dominated by the selected finalizer.

Keep the unchanged tuned down GEMM and its BF16 output. One 256-thread CTA per row uses a 32-KiB FP32 reduction tree plus a 10.5-KiB BF16 row buffer to execute both ordered RMSNorms, persist only the required next-layer residual, and emit the exact E4M3/scale ABI for unchanged QKV.
